subject.title: Skill path resolution rejects Nix-managed symlinks — goplaces skipped

question: Does a current v2026.7.1 activation omit goplaces from `openclaw skills list`, or does it load through `skills.load.extraDirs` while only the duplicate workspace link is rejected?
rationale: Source inspection proves both a rejected workspace-link path and an independent direct-load path, so runtime inventory is necessary to distinguish a functional outage from warning-only duplicate discovery.

options.title: Verify inventory first
options.body: Capture redacted `openclaw skills list` output and matching gateway warnings on v2026.7.1 before selecting the repair.

options.title: Remove workspace links
options.body: Rely exclusively on the generated `skills.load.extraDirs` entries if workspace links are no longer part of the supported contract.

options.title: Trust exact targets
options.body: Generate `allowSymlinkTargets` only for the exact Nix-managed skill roots if workspace links must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Verify inventory first
recommendation.body: Capture redacted `openclaw skills list` output and matching gateway warnings on v2026.7.1 before selecting the repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history around the Home Manager and plugin-packaging surface where both discovery paths are generated.
